thread.hintDocked: Show or hide the thread beside the record (⌘J)
thread.hintView: Open the thread (⌘J); Back returns to the same tab

keys.title: Keyboard
keys.walk: Next and previous message, while the messages have the focus
keys.reply: Reply to the customer, from the thread outside a field
keys.note: Office note, from the thread outside a field
keys.esc: Leave the box (the text stays); from full width back to the record
